headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 0.99 (95% CI: 0.96–1.02), indicating no statistically significant association between eggs and prostate cancer\aggressive. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by low heterogeneity (I² = 0.00%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
